ValidationRule.description: Ensures that when the ID Type is set to 'Passport', the Passport Number field is not left blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__pc, 'Jordan'), ISPICKVAL( ID_Type__pc , 'Passport'), ISBLANK( Passport_Number__pc ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the Passport Number When ID Type is Passport
